statement: The learned finite generalized-convex parametrization recovers the one-item posted price 0.5 and a two-item mixed-bundling menu matching the theoretical benchmark.
assumptions: the two-item symmetric deterministic menu includes no-sale, each singleton, and the bundle
quantifiers: For n=1 recover price 1/2 and revenue 1/4. For n=2 recover singleton price 2/3, bundle price (4-sqrt(2))/3, and the corresponding continuous-domain expected revenue.
full_credit_gate: Optimize the full continuous objective in the finite generalized-convex menu, independently integrate the result, and show pure-separate and pure-bundle controls underperform.
